trigger: Any natal bhava selected for study
operation: Treat that bhava as a temporary ascendant and count the twelve topical houses from it
limitation: A counting method only; does not establish favorable or adverse outcomes without strength and other conditions

trigger: Select a relative's karaka in a natal chart
operation: Treat the sign occupied by that karaka as a temporary ascendant for the relative's twelve houses
limitation: The source names father/Sun and mother/Moon explicitly, with further karakas; this record enables only explicit Sun/father and Moon/mother mappings, not a final prediction

trigger: Bhava, its lord and its karaka are all strong
operation: Traditional favorable reading for that bhava only when all three strengths have been established
limitation: Strength algorithm not implemented; record is deliberately disabled for automatic output

operation: Traditional reading mentions children and fulfilled desires among several topics
limitation: No exact dasha calendar dates or strength/whole-chart judgment yet; do not emit as a personal forecast
